title: Tribes and their mates
summary: How each tribe chooses Kinfolk partners.

claims.text: Kinfolk who mate into another tribe usually come to be seen as Kinfolk of that tribe, though they keep ties to their own.
Get of Fenris are fiercely devoted to family, which for them can include anyone with a drop of Fenrir blood and zeal for the cause.
Shadow Lords pick mates for what they can offer, often wealthy, well-placed Kin; Silver Fangs keep strict dynastic lines of blue-blooded Kinfolk, valuing lineage over money.
Red Talons officially mate only with their wolf Kin, though more than one homid Garou has found a mate among them.
Fellowships are groups of Kinfolk working toward a shared purpose, from local circles of friends to organised, mobile networks.
Some admit only one tribe, such as the Silvertree Genealogical Society of the Silver Fangs; others, like the Locksmiths and Viatopia, welcome all tribes.
Almost all aim to keep communication strong between werewolves and Kin around the world.

title: Tribal limits on Kinfolk Backgrounds
summary: What Kinfolk of each tribe may buy.

claims.text: Bone Gnawer Kin may take neither Pure Breed nor Resources above 3; Glass Walker Kin cannot buy Pure Breed or Mentor.
Red Talon Kin cannot buy Allies, Contacts, Equipment or Resources; Shadow Lord Kin cannot buy Mentor; Silent Strider Kin cannot buy Resources; Wendigo Kin cannot buy Contacts or Resources.
Silver Fang Kin are required to put a Background point or more into Pure Breed.

A Kinfolk can learn a Gift from a spirit called by a willing Theurge, negotiating through an interpreter with Spirit Speech; a spirit pleased by the Kin may also offer to teach unbidden, in a matter of hours.
A Garou may teach a Gift directly, but the Kin must practise for months before it works.
Kinfolk have no Rank, so none may have Gifts above level one, and most lack Gnosis, limiting them to Gifts that need none.

title: Supernatural Kinfolk
summary: Kinfolk who are also vampires, mages, wraiths or changelings.

claims.text: Kin sometimes become vampires, Awaken, linger as wraiths or are born with a faerie nature, though Gaia generally steers the Kin of the Garou away from such fates.
Such a character is built with the rules of the other game and must buy the Supernatural Kinfolk Merit, 4 points or 5 for vampires.
Good relations with Garou relatives are not assumed; a close Garou friend needs the 3-point Werewolf Companion Merit.
